city_localized.description: Localized city name when `?lang=` is specified and a locale other than `en` was found.

country_localized.description: Localized country name when `?lang=` is specified and a locale other than `en` was found.

registered_country.description: Country where the IP block is registered (differs from `country` for VPN exit nodes).

asn_registered.description: ASN registration date from ipverse/as-metadata (YYYY-MM-DD). Null for internal IPs or unknown ASNs.

oneOf.description: Bot identity when the IP is a known crawler range.

iana_label.description: IANA special-purpose address registry label, if applicable.

infra_type.description: Infrastructure dimension, orthogonal to type. One of: internal, cloud, datacenter, government, education, business, residential.

is_c2.description: True when the IP is an active Feodo botnet C2 node.

is_cins.description: True when the IP appears in the CINS Army bad-actor list.

is_internal.description: True when the IP belongs to a private or reserved range (RFC 1918, loopback, link-local, IPv6 ULA).

is_spamhaus.description: True when the IP falls in a Spamhaus DROP/EDROP hijacked netblock.

type.description: Primary signal: highest-priority classification. One of: internal, c2, bot, cloud, vpn, tor, spamhaus, datacenter, residential.

oneOf.description: VPN identity when the IP is a VPN match.

propertyNames.description: The protocol a check belongs to.

Protocol.description: The protocol a check belongs to.

asn.description: ASN that originates this prefix (from MaxMind lookup on the network address).

is_cloud.description: True if the network address is a cloud CIDR.

is_datacenter.description: True if the network address is a datacenter.

is_spamhaus.description: True if the network address matches Spamhaus DROP.

is_vpn.description: True if the network address matches VPN ranges.

network_type.description: Network type classification of the network address.

RecordedKind.description: What the history did with a finished run.

Run.description: One scan as stored for history.

RunAnswer.description: The answer of a fresh run: the run, how the history recorded it, and the diff when it has one.

RunCheck.description:
A check's id, status, findings and evidence references. Findings and evidence are outside
the fingerprint and the diff.

RunSectionEvent.description: One finished section of a running check, as the `section` event of the stream.

SectionWeights.description: One section's weight, its weighted checks and the checks whose failure forces `F`.

Severity.description: How serious a failed check is.

Shape.description: The schema of a [`Shape`], the adjacently tagged union as it serialises.

Threshold.description: One grade threshold as served: the lowest score that earns `grade`.

Value.description: The schema of a [`Value`]: the tagged union as it serialises. An address is its text form.

provider.description: Provider name when identified via ASN heuristic; None when only CIDR matched.
